description: This file defines the LogcatParser class, which parses logcat output streams to extract log entries, including timestamps, process IDs, thread IDs, log levels, tags, and message text.

classes.name: LogcatParser
classes.description: Parser for logcat output stream, extracting log lines and buffer markers.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a sequence of lines from logcat output to produce a Logcat object encapsulating log entries.
